observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the same interior of a shipping container, loaded with dozens of bare used engines stacked on wooden shelving.
A man in a red shirt and red cap stands on the truck bed, leaning into the container to inspect or mark an engine with a pen.
The truck itself is old and rusted; sawdust/packing material is scattered over the lower row of engines.
Upper-tier engines appear more corroded and have visible broken or missing brackets/parts; lower-tier engines look comparatively more intact.
No engine serial numbers, VIN tags, or manufacturer stickers are legible on any individual engine in either photo.
No oil, coolant, or wiring harness is visible to suggest these are complete running assemblies versus stripped long blocks.
The container appears to hold a large bulk lot, not a single clearly separated item for sale.
